title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Payment Operations Standard — When an Installment Is Payable
content:
Each installment of an orthodontic case under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders is tested against the following clauses.

## Clauses in force

1. **Active coverage.** An installment is payable only if the rider is active on the first day of its service period and the case has not been closed.
   - No installment is paid for a service period beginning after the rider termination date.
   - An installment that was not paid because coverage had lapsed is not paid later, unless the coverage is reinstated without a gap.
2. **One per period, and stopping points.** At most one installment may be paid per case and service period (the rider's limit per service period). Installments stop once the case benefit has been paid in full (the payments on the case net of reversals) or the lifetime maximum is reached.
3. **Treatment length.** When treatment ends earlier than planned, the remaining installments are not paid. When treatment runs longer than planned, no installment is added beyond the case benefit.

## Clause no longer in force

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for issuing installments:

- *Retired:* "Each installment is issued on the rider's installment due day of the first month of its service period, following the schedule set at establishment (as revised by a transfer)."

## Evidence for the one-per-period clause

Before an installment is paid, the case's payment records are checked for an installment payment already made on the same case for the same service period. If one exists, no further installment is paid for that period.

| Records for this case and service period | Rider active on the first day of the period, case open | Installment payable |
|---|---|---|
| no installment yet | yes | yes |
| one installment already paid | yes | no |
| no installment yet | no (rider terminated before the period began) | no |

*Hypothetical example:* a rider terminated on 31 March. An installment for the service period beginning 1 April is not payable, while one for the period beginning 1 March is.

superseded_clauses: Each installment is issued on the ortho_installment_due_day of the first month of its service period, following the schedule set at establishment (as revised by a transfer).
